core_obligations: Choose an injective resolution of the image of F on the affine site (proof lines 2543-2546).
Show the image complex under j is exact and consists of injectives (proof lines 2547-2555).
Identify the derived functors of A with RQ applied to j(k(F)) (proof lines 2556-2556).
Apply the vanishing for Q (proof lines 2557-2558).
proof_roadmap: The resolution and its image under j (proof lines 2543-2555).
Identification of the derived functors (proof lines 2556).
Vanishing of Q and conclusion (proof lines 2557-2558).
difficulty_reason: For an affine U = Spec(A) and an adequate module F, the lemma asserts that R^p A(F) = 0 for p > 0, where A is the right adjoint constructed in the previous lemma (statement lines 2533-2540). The proof chooses an injective resolution in the category of O-modules on the affine site, uses the inclusion and cohomology-comparison lemmas to see that the image complex under j is exact and consists of injective presheaves, then identifies the higher derived functors of A with those of Q applied to j(k(F)), so that the result follows from the vanishing for Q (proof lines 2542-2558). The level is H3: the identification of the derived functors of the composite A = Q after j with the derived functors of Q is the load-bearing step and is carried out through a specific resolution.
